title: Deeper/broader LAYOUT viewport-list and last-active audit
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reconcile DWG and DXF LAYOUT viewport-list/last-active field contracts against primary format documentation.
Cross-check current open-source peer work for route and test-design risks without treating peer behavior as normative or independently qualified.
Trace the local parser/writer/adapter/test ownership and refine the existing PAR-40/7G.3e implementation sequence.

crosswalk.evidence: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.84 labels the R2004+ viewport count RL; §2 defines RL as raw long. It then specifies a repeated handle list, and separately lists common handle 331 as last-active viewport. Autodesk DXF LAYOUT docs define 331 as the viewport last active when the layout was current.
crosswalk.disposition: Keep count/list and 331 as separately asserted fields. The format references do not support replacing the list with 331, inferring list-order meaning such as overall viewport, or equating 331 with the live editor pane. The ODA RL vs local/LibreDWG BL wire-type conflict remains unresolved; do not change production encoding until direct sample-bit evidence or authoritative correction resolves it.

crosswalk.evidence: The report distinguishes persisted LAYOUT linkage from live active viewport/UCS context. The maintainer states that its DWG codec had used the last-active link as the overall viewport and changed that derivation to use the layout viewport list.
crosswalk.disposition: Useful peer-reported route-specific risk and test-design signal only. It is not evidence of a libdxfrw defect or independent native-format qualification.

crosswalk.evidence: The merged work adds Layout last-active viewport mapping, preserves a paper viewport, expands layout tests, and separately introduces DXF VIEWPORT code-68 ActiveStatus support.
crosswalk.disposition: Corroborates separation of layout linkage, paper viewport, and status projection as implementation concerns. Peer implementation/tests are not a conformance oracle.

crosswalk.topic: Local route, sample corroboration, and coverage
crosswalk.evidence: The local parser/writer use BitLong; current comments cite LibreDWG FIELD_BL, while ODA says RL. On the existing AC1024 architectural_example-imperial.dwg sample (SHA-256 52d14a7bdb946099d3cf16fd276d19bd8924348fd02b2ddd0003cd4f6b34cce7), the local debug reader reports Layout1 viewportCount=2 and LibreDWG dwgread 0.14 verbose JSON reports num_viewports=2 [BL] with two viewport handles. The local debug command later exits 1 after the reader stage; no full conversion claim is made. Existing generated DWG object round-trip and encoder tests each use one list handle; DXF adapter controls use two but do not exercise the DWG object body path.
crosswalk.disposition: The sample and peer reader corroborate the current decoded count but do not expose the exact source bits independently of BL interpretation. Record the conflict and resolve with a bounded raw-bit/sample trace or authoritative ODA correction before changing parser/writer encoding. After resolution, add a two-entry generated DWG vector under existing 7G.3e; keep it structural-only unless actual VIEWPORT target objects are added.

planChanges.updatedFinding: PAR-40 / 7G.3e DWG LAYOUT viewport-count/list implementation readiness

validation.localCodeTests: NOT_RUN: this was a research and plan-only pass.
validation.localPeerReaderDiagnostic: PASS: installed LibreDWG dwgread 0.14 read the existing AC1024 sample with -v9 -O JSON and reported the two viewport handles; this is corroborative parser output, not an external/native acceptance test.

limitations: Peer issue reports and maintainer-linked changes are not independently reproduced here.
The local and peer readers report the same count, but the exact raw bits at the field were not independently dumped; the ODA RL versus implementation BL discrepancy remains open.
A local structural vector cannot establish target-object ownership, overall viewport selection, application state restoration, or native CAD acceptance.
No external DWG/DXF was added; only repository-local scratch/in-memory test data is proposed.
worktree: Shared worktree broadly modified; no unrelated changes staged or committed.
